mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, closure_id, task_id, project_id, device_id, collection_stage_code, evidence_type_code, collection_task_id, callback_event_id, result_ref, result_version, original_failed_collection_task_id, manual_attachment_id, dispatch_marker, callback_marker, manual_marker, occur_time, record_user_id, creator, create_time, deleted FROM cut_cutover_collection_evidence WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND closure_id = #{query.closureId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY occur_time, id

SELECT id, tenant_id, closure_id, task_id, project_id, device_id, collection_stage_code, evidence_type_code, collection_task_id, callback_event_id, result_ref, result_version, original_failed_collection_task_id, manual_attachment_id, dispatch_marker, callback_marker, manual_marker, occur_time, record_user_id, creator, create_time, deleted FROM cut_cutover_collection_evidence WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND closure_id = #{query.closureId} AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY occur_time, id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cut_cutover_collection_evidence dispatch WHERE dispatch.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND dispatch.closure_id = #{query.closureId} AND dispatch.evidence_type_code = 'DISPATCH_ACCEPTED' AND dispatch.deleted = b'0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cut_cutover_collection_evidence callback WHERE callback.tenant_id = dispatch.tenant_id AND callback.collection_task_id = dispatch.collection_task_id AND callback.evidence_type_code IN ('CALLBACK_SUCCEEDED','CALLBACK_FAILED') AND callback.deleted = b'0' )
